about: Plan 13a held-out homologue set (spec 4.4), drawn by `scripts/homologues.py sample --seed 20261021` from CATH v4_3_0 (CC BY 4.0, https://www.cathdb.info): whole-chain domains of 60-600 residues, entries of the tuning set excluded, each entry at most once. A is the reference, B is drawn like it. Strata: remote (one topology; other superfamily, or identity under 30 %), close (one superfamily, identity 30-90 %), negative (one architecture, other topology). Identity: identical / aligned pairs of foldmap's structure alignment. Measured once (Task 13a-11).
